titleEn: Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Industry and Handicraft

articles.en: - The Ministry of Industry and Handicraft is hereby established under the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
- The Ministry of Industry and Handicraft shall have the competence to lead and manage the industry and handicraft sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
- The Ministry of Industry and Handicraft shall be led by one Minister, who shall be assisted by Secretaries of State and/or Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
- The organisational structure and functioning of the Ministry of Industry and Handicraft shall be determined by sub-decree.

- The industry and handicraft sector, which was previously within the competence of the Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy, shall be under the Ministry of Industry and Handicraft.
Laws and legal instruments relating to the industry, mines and energy sector that are in force shall continue to have effect until re-determined in accordance with the provisions of this Law.
[Illegible in source]
The Minister and Secretaries of State of the Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy who were appointed by Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0913/903 dated 24 September 2013 shall continue to lead and manage the Ministry of Industry and Handicraft until a Minister and Secretaries of State of the Ministry of Industry and Handicraft are appointed.

- The Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy, promulgated by Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/05 dated 24 January 1996, is hereby repealed, and any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.

- This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at the Royal Palace, [date illegible] 2013; Royal signature and seal, Norodom Sihamoni, having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, signature, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen; No. 131 S.Ch.
